lines.text: Good morning.
Morning. Can everyone hear me?
Morning all, I'm in.
Amaka Obi has not joined.

prompts.label: Open the meeting. Type what you say.

lines.text: Let's start with the complaint numbers. Kemi?
Late delivery complaints were 31% of tickets in October, up from 22% in September. Most are from Abuja and Port Harcourt orders.
Tunde, there is an echo on your line.
I can hear myself too.

prompts.label: Put the steps in the order you would take them.

items.text: Ask Tunde whether he is joined on a second device
End the meeting and restart it
Mute Tunde from the host controls
Ask Tunde to leave and rejoin, or join by phone
Ask in chat who else hears the echo
Ask Tunde to use headphones or move away from his speaker

lines.text: Is Amaka joining? We can't decide anything on budget without her.
I can take the comparison first if that helps.
Participants: Amaka Obi is invited and has not joined.

options.text: Message Amaka for her arrival time. Start with the complaint trend and the option comparison. Move the budget check to the end.
Start and decide without Finance. Ask Amaka to confirm later.

lines.text: Having looked at everything, I think we go with Eko Express. It is about ₦1.9m a month cheaper.
Sounds good to me.
Can I flag Abuja and Port Harcourt before we lock that in?
10:14 Amaka Obi joined.
Sorry, I was on another call. Where are we?

prompts.label: What do you record for this item?

options.text: Recommendation: Eko Express (Tunde Bello). Ifeoma Adebayo indicated support. Decision pending budget confirmation by Amaka Obi.
Decision: Eko Express approved subject to budget.

lines.text: The Q1 courier line is ₦8.5m a month. Eko at ₦7.44m fits. SwiftLane at ₦9.38m would need Chinedu's approval.
Before we close, can we also switch our packaging supplier? Same logic, it is cheaper.
Is there a paper on that?
Not yet.
Agenda: the option comparison is 4 minutes over.

prompts.label: Kemi's packaging item has no paper.

options.text: Thank Kemi. Log it for a future agenda. Ask her to send a paper first.
Tell her to email you later.
Summarize the point reached, take the remaining discussion in the decision item, and move on.
Cut the discussion and skip the budget check.

lines.text: Eko have told me informally they can do four days to Abuja and Port Harcourt. Nothing in writing.

Right. We go with Eko Express from 4 January, as long as they confirm Abuja and Port Harcourt delivery in writing. Amaka, send me the budget line in writing. And someone should chase Eko about the delivery times.

afterLines.text: Tunde, by Tuesday. Kemi, send me the packaging paper by Wednesday. We meet again Thursday at 10.
I'll send the budget line on Monday.

prompts.label: What do you do about "someone should chase Eko"?

options.text: Ask: Who owns this, and by what date? Record the answer.
Assign it to Tunde with a deadline, without asking Ifeoma.

lines.text: We are nearly out of time. Please close.
I have to drop at half past.

prompts.label: Close the meeting. Type the recap you give.
